==Resolving Things==

# Change to '''Resolved''' right to  ''Change Status To:''-Button
# press ''Change Status To:''
# Resolve page will open
# change Resolution to '''fixed'''/'''no change required'''
# change '''Fixed in Version'''  ('''ONLY''' when resolution is '''fixed''')
# leave a note
# press ''Resolve Issue''

;Note: Normally the REPORTER should change the Status to '''Closed''' afterwards, when he tested the resolution.

== Duplicate Handling ==

# Change to '''RESOLVED''' in the dropdown right to  ''Change Status To:''-Button
# press ''Change Status To:''
# Resolve page will open
# change Resolution to '''duplicate'''
# insert the '''id''' of the duplicate entry ('''note''': this entry will not be altered)
# Check ''Close immediately:''-checkbox, when the status should be changed to '''CLOSED''' afterwards (for an alternative way, see note)
# leave a note, why this is a duplicate
# press ''Resolve Issue''

;Note:Instead of '''RESOLVED''' it is possible to take '''CLOSED''' in the dropdown, when the bug status was'''NEW'''.
:The ''duplicate ID''-field (''5.'') is '''not shown''', if you take '''CLOSED''' (Limitation of Mantis).
:Therefore you should add the relationship before closing.
